payload.summary: FreshnessStamp has no way to say 'this panel is live' rather than 'revision unknown'
payload.detail: The ingestion panel is deliberately live, so it has no build revision to stamp. PanelPageShell's FreshnessStamp therefore lands on its 'revision unknown' branch, which its own comment documents as the case for a BROKEN or unparseable date - not for a panel that intentionally has none. The page reads 'Ingestion jobs revision unknown' directly under the title, one line above a paragraph explaining it is read live. It is the least-bad option today: the alternative, stamping a fabricated build-time date over live numbers, is exactly what the plan forbids. The real fix is a first-class 'live' mode on FreshnessStamp so a panel can say when it last fetched instead of that it has no revision. Deferred rather than fixed because the shared component is used by five pages and the explanatory copy is already adjacent.
